info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: listArticles returns the help center's published, public articles without bodies.
get.description:
listArticles returns the help center's published, public articles without bodies. The
tenant is fixed at mount and the published/public filter is server-set, so a caller
can widen neither.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category narrows the list to one knowledge-base section, by category name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the articles returned; 0 means 50 and nothing above 200 is honoured.

data.excerpt: Use the reset link on the sign-in page.
data.title: Reset my password

get.summary: getArticle returns one published, public article by slug.
get.description:
getArticle returns one published, public article by slug. The article's document name
IS its slug, and a missing, Draft, or internal (non-public) article is 404 —
fail-closed, no existence oracle beyond "published + public".

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Slug is the article's URL slug, which is also its document name.

example.excerpt: Use the reset link on the sign-in page.
example.title: Reset my password

get.summary: listCategories returns the knowledge-base sections that front a public article.
get.description:
listCategories returns the knowledge-base sections that front a public article. Only
sections carrying at least one Published + public article are listed, so an internal
(agent-only) category name or description never leaks; an org with no public articles
has no sections (empty, not an error).

post.summary: fileTicket opens a support ticket from an anonymous customer submission.
post.description:
fileTicket opens a support ticket from an anonymous customer submission. The ticket is
created status Open, source portal, with the customer's message on the description,
and that message is then recorded as the opening conversation entry — the description
carries it regardless, so failing to write the entry loses nothing.

body.description: Body is the rendered article text.

category.description: Category is the knowledge-base section the article sits in.

excerpt.description: Excerpt is the short summary shown in a list.

slug.description: Slug is the article's URL slug.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the last edit, as a unix timestamp in seconds.

category.description: Category is the knowledge-base section the article sits in.

excerpt.description: Excerpt is the short summary shown in a list.

slug.description: Slug is the article's URL slug.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the last edit, as a unix timestamp in seconds.

data.description: Data is the published, public articles, newest content first as the store returns them.

name.description: Name is the section's name, which is also its document name.

data.description: Data is the sections that front at least one published, public article.

description.description: Description is the customer's message. Clipped to 16 KiB.

email.description: Email is the customer's address, and the party the ticket is filed against. Required.

priority.description: Priority is one of low, medium, high or urgent; anything else means medium.

subject.description: Subject is the one-line summary. Required; clipped to 300 characters.

status.description: Status is the ticket's lifecycle state, always Open on intake.

ticket.description: Ticket is the opaque customer-facing reference; the internal ticket number is not disclosed.
